_classes.name: duplicate_provision gate drops joint-actor records that share one quote (rule says one record per body, same quote allowed)
_classes.rule: dropped/*.json rule=='duplicate_provision' and dropped.quote[:150]==quote[:150] of the record named in reason 'overlaps <id>' (dropped rows carry no actor, so this is an upper bound; 4 of 5 random matches were real joint actors: 2015-S4472-15, 2019-A5762-05, 2009-S2849-26, 2011-S6736-15; 2011-A8496-11 looked a true duplicate)

_classes.name: court and legislative-leader actors left Unspecified
_classes.rule: agency=='Unspecified' and re.search(r'\b(court|minority leader|majority leader|speaker|temporary president)\b', actor_raw, I) (19 of the 30 are courts)

_classes.name: list items under a mandatory passive lead-in ('The informational leaflet shall also include:') dropped as designation_no_actor
_classes.rule: dropped/*.json rule=='designation_no_actor' and agency not in (None,'Unspecified') (453 of 476; candidates, the real ones need reading of the lead-in)

_classes.name: one-time setup duty with no stated deadline stored as deadline none (should be on_effective_date); same law gives sibling list items on_effective_date
_classes.rule: kind=='duty' and recurrence=='one-time' and deadline_kind=='none' and not deadline_text

_classes.name: list item flipped to power by a 'may' inside a relative clause, against a 'The council shall:' lead-in (recurrence of the Oct 17 class)
_classes.rule: kind=='power' and kind_list_item is True and kind_model=='duty'

_classes.name: savings clause ('Nothing contained in this act shall be deemed to alter the authority of ...') stored as a record
'the applicable governing body or tax department' in assessor special acts resolved inconsistently (Villages vs Counties for the same Nassau sentence)
_classes.rule: re.search('applicable governing body', actor_raw, I); agency spread Towns 41, Counties 24, Municipalities (all) 16, Cities 8, Villages 6, Unspecified 3; Villages rows are the likely errors

_classes.name: local-option threshold ('as may be provided by local law') stored as a duty
_classes.rule: kind=='duty' and re.search(r'as may be provided by (the )?local law', quote, I)
